This 7-bedroom, 6-bathroom retreat comfortably hosts up to 15 guests, offering the perfect setting for family vacations or group getaways, nestled between the Gulf and Eastern Lake. This home is thoughtfully designed for both relaxation and entertainment. Unwind on the spacious lower deck, where you’ll find a private pool, outdoor shower, natural gas grill, lounge chairs, and plenty of seating—ideal for enjoying ocean breezes and coastal sunsets. The Carriage House includes a king bedroom, a cozy living area, and a full bathroom, providing a quiet retreat within the property. Convenience and comfort come together with on-site parking for six vehicles, 8 complimentary adult bikes, and golf cart, making it easy to explore the scenic charm of Highway 30A. Located just a short stroll from the sugar-white sands and turquoise waters, Casa Bella invites you to relax, recharge, and make lasting memories by the sea!

Description Welcome to 'Casa Bella,'  a luxurious coastal escape in Seagrove Beach with sweeping views of the Emerald Coast and a private Carriage House. This 7-bedroom, 6-bathroom retreat comfortably hosts up to 15 guests, offering the perfect setting for family vacations or group getaways, nestled between the Gulf and Eastern Lake. This home is thoughtfully designed for both relaxation and entertainment. Unwind on the spacious lower deck, where you’ll find a private pool, outdoor shower, natural gas grill, lounge chairs, and plenty of seating—ideal for enjoying ocean breezes and coastal sunsets. The Carriage House includes a king bedroom, a cozy living area, and a full bathroom, providing a quiet retreat within the property. Convenience and comfort come together with on-site parking for six vehicles, 8 complimentary adult bikes, and golf cart, making it easy to explore the scenic charm of Highway 30A. Located just a short stroll from the sugar-white sands and turquoise waters, Casa Bella invites you to relax, recharge, and make lasting memories by the sea! ACCOMMODATIONS: Sleeps: 15 7 Bedrooms / 6.5 Baths FIRST FLOOR: Bedroom #1 - King Bed, with Ensuite Bedroom #2 - King Bed, with Shared Bath SECOND FLOOR:  Bedroom #3 - King Bed, with Shared Bath Bedroom #4 - King Bed, with Shared Bath Bedroom #5 - Bunk Room Queen/Twin, with Ensuite THIRD FLOOR: Bedroom #6 - King Bed, with Ensuite CARRIAGE HOUSE Bedroom #7,  King Bed, with Shared Bath HOME HIGHLIGHTS: Gulf & Lake Views Carriage House 6-Seater Golf Cart 8 Bikes- Adult Large Covered Balconies featuring Seating and Entertainment Areas Private Pool- Heated upon request **Pool Heating is Available for an Additional Fee of $50/day Sun Loungers Poolside Large Screen TV Beach Gear Gas Grill Fully Stocked Gourmet Kitchen Smart TVs Throughout Home Elevator 6 Dedicated Parking Spots **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | Pool Towels WELCOME BUNDLE: Coffee Grounds | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water BEACH ACCESS Three public beach accesses a short distance from the home: 1. San Roy Beach Access is at the end of San Roy Road on the eastern side of the Eastern Lake outfall, about 1/4 mile south of Scenic 30A and just a 3 minute walk from the home! Eastern Lake is one of our rare coastal dune lakes in SoWal, which periodically open to exchange waters with the gulf. The access has minimal parking. 2. Sugar Dune Beach Access in Seagrove Beach is about 1/2 mile south of Scenic 30A at the end of Beachside Drive on the east side of Eastern Lake. There is a shower and a short boardwalk over the dunes to the beach. 3. Walton Dunes Beach Access has a small parking lot, but no bathrooms, and is located just west of the Deer Lake State Park boundary. This access has no steps-just walk straight onto the beach. One of our personal favorites and just a 3 minute golf cart ride away from the home! **Should you desire to have beach chair service (chairs and umbrellas set-up), the company that provides these amenities is Big Fish Bike & Beach Rental. During busy summer months, it's best to rent your chairs and umbrellas in advance. When making reservations online (or over the phone), you would choose "Seagrove Dunes" as the location. PARKING Six parking spaces available (4 driveway). No street parking allowed. No RV or trailer parking in the driveway. Included are 8 bicycles (adult) and a 6-seater golf cart for your convenience.  SEAGROVE BEACH COMMUNITY HIGHLIGHTS: Seagrove Beach is a charming coastal community that is on 30a, nestled between Seaside and Watersound. The property is located within a short walk to a private community pool and two access points to the beautiful Emerald Coast beaches - one directly to the beach, and one to Eastern Lake, a coastal dune lake that flows right into the gulf- a phenomena that is found in one of 4 places in the World. You ll find restaurants and shops within walking distance, and a quick bike ride will land you in Seaside, a well-known 30A spot with farmers markets, shops, restaurants, and local food trucks to fill your entire party s needs. Take a quick bike ride east in the opposite direction, and you can find yourself at the Big Chill, a popular outdoor space filled with restaurants, outdoor games, and big screen TVs to watch any sporting event your heart desires. 30A is located in between the beach and a 15,000-acre forest that is filled with hiking trails and off-road trails, for those that want to skip the beach and want a different experience. Flying in from out of town instead of driving? Flying into ECP (Panama Beach City) airport is a 30 minute drive to the house. Flying into VPS (Destin airport) is a little over a 1 hour drive. HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck. *No parties or events. *Complimentary golf cart can only be operated by guests over 25 years of age who provide verification. Rental agreement requires a valid drivers license and proof of existing auto insurance coverage. *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi. *Private Heated Pool  **Pool heating is available for an additional fee of $50/day. Must be heated for duration of stay.  If selected, it must be requested 48 hours prior to check in and paid before the heater will be turned on. *Home must remain pet free! IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver s license and 2) a "selfie".
